# is_draft Implicit Default Tests

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

# --- Write new page without is_draft ---
stdin ../new-page.md
exec akb write new-page.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/new-page.md'

# --- Verify is_draft is NOT in written frontmatter ---
exec akb read notes/new-page.md
! stdout 'is_draft:'

# --- Write explicit draft page ---
stdin ../explicit-draft.md
exec akb write explicit-draft.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/explicit-draft.md'

# --- Verify is_draft:true is stripped from frontmatter ---
exec akb read notes/explicit-draft.md
! stdout 'is_draft:'

# --- Approve new page adds is_draft: false ---
exec akb approve notes/new-page.md
stdout 'Approved ''notes/new-page.md'''

# --- Verify is_draft: false is now present ---
exec akb read notes/new-page.md
stdout 'is_draft: false'

# --- Approve explicit-draft page ---
exec akb approve notes/explicit-draft.md
stdout 'Approved ''notes/explicit-draft.md'''

# --- Verify is_draft: false is now present ---
exec akb read notes/explicit-draft.md
stdout 'is_draft: false'

-- new-page.md --
---
type: note
title: New Page
summary: A new page
tags: test
---
Body content.

-- explicit-draft.md --
---
type: note
title: Explicit Draft
summary: With is_draft true
tags: test
is_draft: true
---
Draft body.
